pages.text: Weaken a creature below a quarter of its health and use the $(item)Surgical Saw$() on it: its head comes off and its body stays up, ready for a jar. With an empty $(item)Life Support Jar$() in your off hand you keep the $(l)head$() instead.

As a jar, use a host to climb on. It moves where you look, its own abilities answer $(k:key.headinajar.ability) and $(k:key.headinajar.secondary), and it slowly rots unless you embalm it. Sync grows the longer you pilot it.
